extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and authors conducting rapid evaluation and appraisal studies (observational, qualitative, mixed-methods, quality improvement), plus journal editors and peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: A named reporting guideline (STREAM) for Standards for Rapid Evaluation and Appraisal Methods, intended to guide reporting of observational, qualitative, mixed-methods, and service quality improvement studies using rapid evaluation approaches. The guideline is presented as applying to the whole report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting guideline applicability (study types)
rubrics_metrics.description: This reporting guideline will apply to observational studies, qualitative research and mixed methods studies, service quality improvement studies and any study using rapid evaluation approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the authors' stated scope for STREAM (i.e., the exact types of studies to which the guideline should be applied). Full bibliographic reference: Clark SE, Vera San Juan N, Vindrola-Padros C. Developing Standards for Rapid Evaluation and Appraisal Methods (STREAM): An e-Delphi Consensus Study. J Eval Clin Pract. 2025 Aug;31(5):e70207. DOI: 10.1111/jep.70207. Full text and STREAM website are linked from the record for detailed checklist items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of application within a report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline is intended to cover reporting across the entire manuscript/report rather than being limited to individual sections. Consult the full STREAM guideline (linked) for section-level items and checklist details.
